name: signal
description: Dominio SIGNAL (scipy.signal) via FFI: finestre (hann/hamming/blackman), convoluzione/correlazione, design e applicazione di filtri IIR (butter/cheby1/cheby2/ellip + lfilter/filtfilt/freqz), FIR (firwin), picchi (findpeaks), ricampionamento (resample/decimate), smoothing Savitzky-Golay e densita' spettrale (welch). Sorgenti canonici in gmbsuite/gmbsignal, copia self-contained qui.

ffi.declareExample: DECLARE NATIVE FUNCTION SXF_HANN LIB "gmbsignal" ALIAS "ofx_signal_hann" (n AS LONG, out() AS DOUBLE, cap AS LONG) AS LONG
